An HFSS Eigenmode run set up for EPR saves its final fields. This guide
evaluates EPR on those saved fields, for example with different surface
margins, without solving again. It still opens AEDT, so it needs AEDT 2024.2,
PyAEDT 1.3.0 and a licence. To change only loss tangents, no AEDT is needed;
see [Change loss assumptions offline](offline-epr.qmd).

::: {.callout-note title="Before you start"}
- A finished HFSS Eigenmode run that was set up with an EPR request, such as
  the [resonance tutorial](../tutorials/resonance-epr/prepare.qmd) HFSS tab or the
  [Xmon HFSS example](../tutorial-xmon-aedt.qmd). A plain
  [HFSS Eigenmode](aedt-eigenmode.qmd) run does not save the required fields.
- The **whole** returned run directory. A `.aedt` project file alone is not
  enough.
:::

## Step 1: Load the run and its saved fields

Read the specification from the run directory itself, so that the geometry
and settings are exactly those of the run:

```python
import json
from pathlib import Path
from scgsim.aedt import parse_aedt_spec, resolve_saved_solution

run_dir = Path(".artifacts/returned-aedt-epr")
spec = parse_aedt_spec(json.loads((run_dir / "aedt_spec.json").read_text()))
saved = resolve_saved_solution(run_dir / "saved-solution-manifest.json")
```

`resolve_saved_solution` checks, without opening AEDT, that every saved file
is present and unchanged. It raises an error if anything is missing or
modified.

## Step 2: Evaluate EPR

```python
from scgsim.aedt import analyze_epr

final_epr = analyze_epr(
    saved_solution=saved,
    geometry=spec.geometry,
    project_name=spec.project_name,
    design_name=spec.design_name,
    run_control=spec.run_control,
    epr_request=spec.epr_request,
    output_dir=Path(".artifacts/xmon-saved-field-analysis"),
)
```

`analyze_epr` copies the saved project into the new `output_dir`, opens the
copy in AEDT, and evaluates the requested EPR expressions on the saved
fields. The original run directory is not changed. No solve runs. If the
fields or expressions are not available, it raises an error.

To evaluate different surface margins, pass a modified `epr_request`.

## Step 3: Read the result

The result is written to `results/epr/epr-result.json` in the output
directory. It describes the final fields only; it has no per-pass history.
The adaptive-pass history of the original run is a separate file; see
[Change loss assumptions offline](offline-epr.qmd#aedt-results).
